title: a novel deep learning framework with advanced feature engineering for hate speech detection in accented malayalam speech
core_idea: Develop a comprehensive deep learning framework for hate speech detection in accented Malayalam speech by curating a diverse dataset (YouTube videos and movies), extracting extensive acoustic features (ZCR, STFT, MFCC, RMS, mel spectrogram) producing multi-level feature vectors, applying data augmentation (noise injection, time stretching, pitch shifting), employing SMOTE-based class balancing, and evaluating robustness and generalization through speaker-independent validation and Gaussian-noise perturbations while comparing multiple classifiers including a customized 1D-CNN, SVM, Random Forest, XGBoost, and LightGBM.
tldr: A framework to detect hate speech in accented Malayalam speech using advanced acoustic feature engineering, augmentation, class balancing, and robustness-focused validation across multiple classifiers.
